rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=24, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-16 (one knob vs iter-15 best). NUMBERS soft_thresh(n_bands24,n_outer1): 0.0007->hr0.0299, 0.0003->0.0343, 0.0001->0.0365(iter-15 BEST) -- monotone-improving as thresh->0; the 24-band single-pass residual is clean genuine structure and thresholding only costs RMSE. FAILURE MODE: any positive thresh discards true aliasing-residual detail. ONE KNOB: wu_soft_thresh 0.0001 -> 0.0 (NO thresholding, pure single-pass residual add-back; n_bands locked 24). HYPOTHESIS: if the residual is fully genuine at 24 bands, zero thresh adds it all back and gives the lowest RMSE -> hr above 0.0365; if there is a tiny irreducible noise floor in the residual, hr(0.0)<=hr(0.0001) and thresh=0.0001 is the confirmed optimum. This closes the soft_thresh axis. Budget: ~seconds.
